tips.summon: Welcome! Drag a troop from your hand onto your back row (the bottom row, next to your Stronghold) to summon it. You have 0 crystals, but a Gatherer is free when you are broke.
tips.move: Nice! Now march it forward: press Done to reach the Action phase, then drag your troop to an empty space. Gatherers may move the turn they appear. Each troop either moves OR attacks.
tips.swap: Next turn, play your Crystal card for 1 crystal and summon a second Gatherer. Then in the Action phase drag one of your troops onto the other to swap places (it must be within its move range).
tips.capture: Walk next to a crystal mine in the middle. Have more troops around it than the enemy and it turns your color. Every troop around a mine makes flow: Gatherer 2, Fighter 1, and your pool is set to your flow each turn.
tips.spend: Crystals are your money. Your pool resets to your flow every turn, so spend them! Summon a troop or upgrade one. Crystals of other colors are worth only half toward troops.
tips.fight: Time to fight! In the Action phase drag a troop onto the enemy troop. Melee hits are simultaneous: both strike. Damage heals at the start of your next turn.
tips.spell: Cast a spell! Drag Fireball from your hand onto an enemy (spells cost crystals of any color).
tips.commander: Finally, move next to the enemy Stronghold and attack the Commander. Each hit removes health equal to the attacker's Attack. Make them retreat!
